newsitem.title: USA: Susquehanna Bancshares sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Susquehanna Bancshares sets stock split.

text.p: Susquehanna Bancshares Inc said on Thursday that its directors had approved a three-for-two stock split to take the form of a 50 percent stock dividend to be paid on July 2.
The dividend will be paid to shareholders of record on June 10, the company said in a statement.

The stock split, meant to bring the company's per share price on common stock into a more favorable trading range, will increase the number of oustanding shares to around 21,967,000, the company said.

The board of directors also declared a third quarter dividend of $0.21 per share on its common stock, payable August 20 to shareholders of record July 10. The dividend represents a 5 percent increase over the $0.20 paid in the second quarter, the company added.
Susquehanna is a multi-bank financial holding company.
